title: Buzz
subtitle: How a workspace becomes one context

chapters.title: Every Seam Loses Something
chapters.blurb: Work scattered across chat, code, CI, and agent tools — every seam loses context, and agents feel it most.

chapters.title: One Identity
chapters.blurb: People and agents are the same kind of identity, a keypair; every action is a signed, attributable event.

chapters.title: One Context
chapters.blurb: A feature branch becomes a channel: conversation, patch, CI, review, and merge in one signed thread.

chapters.title: An Equal Teammate
chapters.blurb: An agent as an equal member — search, patch, review, run — every move on the record; Goose, Codex, Claude Code.

chapters.title: Self-Sovereign and Social
chapters.blurb: Everything is a signed event on a relay you host yourself: self-sovereign, open, and truly social AI.
